text: Notorious with The General is the paragon quest for The General, immediately available to turn in to Aspirant Kiipka in Weaver's Lair in Azj-Kahet each time players fill out the paragon reputation with the faction.

Notorious with The Vizier is the paragon quest for The Vizier, immediately available to turn in to Tulumun in Weaver's Lair in Azj-Kahet each time players fill out the paragon reputation with the faction.

Notorious with The Weaver is the paragon quest for The Weaver, immediately available to turn in to Bobbin in Weaver's Lair in Azj-Kahet each time players fill out the paragon reputation with the faction.
Novelist's Specs are created with Khaz Algar Jewelcrafting (35); taught by Design: Novelist's Specs.
Northshire Crusader is an ally card from the War of the Ancients set.
Nostwin's Impatience is a Legion: Remix artifact trait. It costs .
Not-Quite-Crystal Ball is sold by the following vendors in Undermine for : *Jako the Collector *Lange *Thydrinos *Welanithim
Noxious Injector Brainbulb drops from The Underpin in Demolition Dome. It is also an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Noxious Injector Apparatus.
Noxious Injector Footpads is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Noxious Injector Apparatus.

Notorious Thread's Hearthstone is sold by Yamas the Provider in The Weaver's Lair in Azj-Kahet for . 3 variants can also be added: the Crypt Lord's Severed Thread, the Executor's Severed Thread, and the Spymaster's Severed Thread.
Nostwin's Snacks and Snoozles is an inn run by Nostwin at the isle south of Dalaran during Legion Remix.
Now It's A Party is a prey achievement earned by completing a nightmare hunt while in War Mode.
Notgarn is a nightsaber. It was the objective of a scrapped quest, along with Rashar and Sekhan.
Nouget is a rat running around the pipes in the Vatworks in Undermine.
Now You Don't See Me... is a world event achievement earned by not get tagged in the first minute of Decor Duel three times.
Northshire Scribe's Desk is housing decor obtained as a quest reward from Bigger is Better (Alliance). Additional copies can be purchased from Sergeant Crowler in Lunarfall for .
Novice Combatant's Medallion was a quest reward from Early Morning Training: Week 1 of 4.
Novice Combatant's Insignia of Alacrity is a quest reward from Late Night Training: Week 1 of 3.
Novice Combatant's Emblem is a quest reward from Late Night Training: Week 1 of 3.
Noxious Corrosive Coin is looted from the Broken Urn in the Vaults of Atal'Utek on the Coiled Isle. Upon looting it, the adventurer is afflicted with: :
Nox the Lifedrainer is an ally card from the Crown of the Heavens set.

Nyhm is a somewhat well-known World of Warcraft machinima producer who is best known for his numerous videos on YouTube. He is a former member of Alleria, where he once played a warlock. He created parodies of known songs at the time, his songs' lyrics sounding close to the original.

Nuts is a squirrel located in the Hall of Beasts of Dazar'alor. In Operation Toy Rescue, part of Guest Relations during WoW's Anniversary, Horde characters help Nuts reacquire the Plush Toy that was stolen from him.

Nyla Bushtail is a fol'ya located in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream. She is an engineer assistant, and Magnolia Oaken heard Nyla being described as a legendary engineer who crafts beautiful dream catchers and enjoys acorn-flavored morels and relies on them to fuel her work.
Nymue, Weaver of the Cycle is a boss in Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope.
Nuoberon is a gorilla located at the Fields of Reverie in the Emerald Dream.
Nymue's Unraveling Spindle drops from Nymue in Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope.
Oana's Observant Gaze drops from: *Mage Lord Gogg'nathog *Lady Fleshsear *Gaur *Teluur *Commander Dro'gan *Annihilon
O'nank Shorescour is a sea giant located in the Restless Wetlands in the Waking Shores.

O.D.I.E. are mechanical dogs located at the at the Gala of Gifts next to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt by the Stormwind Gate in Elwynn Forest and Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Durotar during Love is in the Air. It can be petted.
Nozand is a vulpera of Keg Leg's Crew located in Brew Bay in the Arathi Highlands during Plunderstorm. Nozand is chasing Pincushion.

Oath Gate serves as the eastern entrance to Dornogal. It leads directly to the Stoneshaper's Atrium and further to Keepers Terrace and Foundation Hall further west. Stoneward's Rise is to the north, Councilward's Rise is to the northwest, and the Fissure is to the southwest.
Nynthia is an Arathi located with Geoffy in Mereldar in Hallowfall.

Null Slivers act as catchup knowledge for Khaz Algar Mining. After all of the current week's standard knowledge sources have been completed (Slab of Slate, Erosion Polished Slate, and Tarib's quest), Null Slivers have a chance to drop from any Khaz Algar mining node, up to the current Khaz Algar Mining Knowledge cap. They are tiny fragments of , though they have no use in crafting.
Oath-Eater is a tidal guardian located in the Shimmermist Falls in the Ringing Deeps.
Oath of the Sea is sold by Duke Hydraxis in for upon reaching with the Hydraxian Waterlords. It transforms the user into a water elemental and grants water breathing for 5 minutes.

Ny'alotha Obelisk is located at in the phase or in the phase on the roof of the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms. This is the 2 o'clock part of the Keys to Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle in Ratts' Revenge. While buffed with The Light of Their Love (for the 1 o'clock orb), the Crumpled Notes in the north connecting hallway read: In the phase of the Vale, bring out the Perky Pug, equip the "Yipp-Saron" Costume (from Hallow's End) or "Dogg-Saron" Costume (from Vashti the Wandering Merchant for ) on it, then use the Twitching Eyeball or All-Seeing Eyes toys or wear the Gift of N'Zoth, target the Ny'alotha Obelisk, and /pray. After a while, the Key of Shadows will get pushed
Noxious Myceliums are lashrooms located outside Rak-Ush in Azj-Kahet.

Null Stone is a crafting reagent used in several Khaz Algar professions, including blacksmithing, enchanting, engineering, jewelcrafting, and tailoring. 5 Imperfect Null Stones can be combined to form 1 Null Stone. Null Stones additionally have a low chance to be fished up in Khaz Algar.
Oathsworn Administrator is an earthen ocated at the Forgegrounds in Dornogal who can be seen speaking with a recently arrived goblin named Norb.
Nunchuck of the Renaissance is available for purchase from the Trading Post for 120 Trader's Tender.

The Ny'alothan Shadow Worm is a shadow serpent mount rewarded by the Mastering the Visions achievement, which requires fully clearing both Horrific Visions Revisited with all eight Faceless Masks active.
Null Lotus is a crafting reagent that can be rarely-found alongside other herbs while gathering in zones from expansion.
Nutraal is a dracthyr located in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.
Nubagh is a duck located east of Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains during Grand Hunts.

The OC91 Chariot is an ironstrider mount that can be purchased for 10,000 Resonance Crystals from Reno Jackson at the Delver's Headquarters in Dornogal. During The War Within Season 2, it was rewarded by the Titan Console Overcharged achievement, which required purchasing all 17 upgrades from the Overcharged Titan Console in Overcharged Delves. During The War Within Season 3 until the release of , it was available for purchase from Sir Finley Mrrgglton for 15,000 .
The Oathbinder's Pledge can be found at the back of Woldkeeper Freydrin's home in Boskroot Basin during Wold Memories.
Nur is a slateback located in Astral Getaways in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market in K'aresh.
Oasis Animal Leavings are found at the Oasis on K'aresh. The Cartel Om Custodian wants them collected for Custodian Duties as part of Ecological Succession.
Oath-Breaker's Recompense drops from Nexus-King Salhadaar in Manaforge Omega.
Nyz'raal the Umbral Blade is an ethereal who attacks Locus-Walker and Alleria Windrunner in the P.O.S.T. in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market during The Darkness Among Us.
Nyala Shadefury is an ally card from the War of the Ancients set.
Nozaro, Staff of the Heavens was a planned priest item found in Ashran. The effect was scaled back a bit and repurposed into Codex of Ascension.
Noxious Injector Manacles is looted from Overcharged Chest and Jettisoned Pile of Goblin-Bucks. It is also an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Noxious Injector Apparatus.
Noxious Injector Tube is looted from Jettisoned Pile of Goblin-Bucks and Hidden Trove. It is also an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Noxious Injector Apparatus.
Noxious Injector Mantle drops from The Underpin in Demolition Dome. It is also an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Noxious Injector Apparatus.
Noxious Injector Trousers drop from The Underpin in Demolition Dome. It is also an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Noxious Injector Apparatus.
Noxious Injector Hands is looted from Overcharged Chest and Jettisoned Pile of Goblin-Bucks. It is also an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Noxious Injector Apparatus.

Noxious Injector Harness is looted from Cache of Delver's Spoils, Overcharged Chest and Jettisoned Pile of Goblin-Bucks. It is also an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Noxious Injector Apparatus.
Noxious Injector Sheen is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Noxious Injector Apparatus.
Null Glimmers are dracthyr projections summoned by the Scalecommander Sarkareth in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.
Nullification Devices are titan orbs summoned by Watcher Irideus in Halls of Infusion.
Oathspeaker Al'joul is an ethereal located at North Sufaad on K'aresh.

Nullaeus is a domanaar playing the role as the delves nemesis during Midnight Season 1. He also has a chance to ambush players during a normal delve. While in an encounter with other mobs in a delve, Nullaeus has a chance to ambush the encounter. During this time, getting Nullaeus down a bit of health will prompt him to cast a shield and summon 2 Razorshell Ravagers. Defeat them and Nullaeus will portal out and leave behind a Nullaeus Cache, otherwise killing all players will promptly have him leave the delve with no reward left behind.
Nullwalker's Dread Epaulettes drop from Vaelgor & Ezzorak in the Voidspire.

Null Voidfish is a fish and crafting reagent that can be fished in waters from . They are used in recipes across a variety of professions. Adventurers seeking to learn the recipe for School of Gems will require eight of these fish in their inventory when interacting with Camberon's Cauldron.
Nysarra's Mantle drops from Corewarden Nysarra in Nexus-Point Xenas.
Noxious Weavers are aranasi found at the Shadow Fracture on the Broken Shore when Arachnid Superiority is up.
Oath Scale is housing decor that can be purchased for 5 Community Coupons from Aeeshna, who appears in neighborhoods as part of the Consortium Consternation endeavor.

O.D.I.E.'s Remote Control is given to the player by Detective Snap Snagglebolt or Inspector Snip Snagglebolt upon accepting I Smell Trouble. It summons O.D.I.E.. It is also used during the quest An Unwelcome Gift.
Nutrient-Rich Soil are looted from piles of Nutrient Rich Dirt along the river and in the water in Nai'theren Grotto in Harandar.
Null Stabilizer is located at on a workbench in Stormarion Keep in the Voidstorm.
Nullbots are haulbots located in the Ritual Hall in the Hall of Awakening.
Nullaeus Domaneye is an achievement reward from My Shady Nemesis.
Nullstrider's Boots drop from named trash mobs in the Voidspire and March on Quel'Danas.
Grand Nullifiers are domanaar located in the Core Defense Nullward in Nexus-Point Xenas.
Nullatros is a voidcaller located in Voidscar Arena. Along with Vexaroth, Obliron, and Nyxovar, it must be slain in order to reach Charonus.
Nyxovar is a voidwraith located in Voidscar Arena. Along with Vexaroth, Nullatros, and Obliron, it must be slain in order to reach Charonus.
Noxious Shamblers are Maldraxxi abominations found at the Stitchyard in Maldraxxus during Charging The Blade (Kyrian) and Charging The Blade (Necrolord).

The Nullaeus Cache is left behind by Nullaeus after he randomly breaches a delve to attack and then leaves. He can be forced to flee by defeating his summoned minions, or he'll leave after killing all players in the delve but the cache will not be left behind.
Null and Avoided is a world event achievement earned by successfully loosing the Found status without being tagged in Decor Duel.
Nymrissa Wavecaller is a world boss in the Tidebound Grotto.
Oaths and Heirlooms is an optional breadcrumb that starts the Oaths to Family questline.
Nullframe Holoprint is located in the Staging Grounds on Naigtal.
Nunchucks of the Artisan are available for purchase at the Trading Post for 120 Trader's Tender.
Nymrissa Wavecaller Guild Run is a guild raid achievement earned by defeating Nymrissa Wavecaller in the Tidebound Grotto on Normal difficulty or higher while in a guild group.
Oasis Securities are brokers that spawn during the Myza's Oasis encounter in the Tazavesh, the Veiled Market dungeon.

Nutek the Abductor is a serpent in the service of Malacrass during the War of Light and Shadow. A member of the Children of Ula'tek, Nutek was one of those entrusted with securing sacrifices for Malacrass' blood ritual. Alongside others of his kind, Nutek invaded the Witherbark Bluffs and swiftly met defending Amani warriors in battle. Despite the best efforts of Zul'jarra, who referred to Nutek as a "monster brute," and her allies, many villagers were stolen away to the Coiled Isle across the Strait of Hexx'alor. Nutek, however, was slain shortly before the conclusion of the skirmish.
Nyalah Brightfire is a Skyborne Cooking trainer located in Valanaar on Zephras Isle.
Nozdormu the Timeless is a master hero card from the War of the Elements set depicting Nozdormu.
Obsidian Combatant's Adamant Epaulets are created with Dragon Isles Leatherworking (35); taught by Pattern: Obsidian Combatant's Adamant Epaulets.
Obsidian Aspirant's Silk Hood is sold by Seltherex in Valdrakken for .
Obsidian Aspirant's Chain Gauntlets are sold by Seltherex in Valdrakken for .
Obsidian Combatant's Draconium Armguards are created with Dragon Isles Blacksmithing (35); taught by Plans: Obsidian Combatant's Draconium Armguards.
Obsidian Combatant's Wildercloth Tunic is created with Dragon Isles Tailoring (35); taught by Pattern: Obsidian Combatant's Wildercloth Tunic.
Obsidian Combatant's Wildercloth Gloves are created with Dragon Isles Tailoring (35); taught by Pattern: Obsidian Combatant's Wildercloth Gloves.
Obsidian Bickern drops from mobs at the Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores.
Observational Pollen Guards are runebears located in the Meandering Rootlands in the Emerald Dream.

Oblivion Sphere is a meta gem in Pandaria Remix. It can drop from any creature, be contained in a Cache of Infinite Treasure, or the Asynchronized Meta Gem, purchased from Lidamorrutu for 500 Bronze (Pandaria Remix), has a chance of creating this gem.
Oathsworn Workers are earthen located in the Forgegrounds in Dornogal and at the Crossroads Plaza on the Isle of Dorn. Some are seen driving carts pulled by Cart Haulers.
Oathsworn Dignitaries are earthen located in the Foundation Hall in Dornogal.
Oathsworn Councilguards are earthen located at the Councilward's Rise in Dornogal.
Obsessed Prophet's Chestplate is sold by Zalgo the Explorer for .
Obsessed Prophet's Plate is a plate set sold by Zalgo the Explorer.
Obsessed Prophet's Legguards are sold by Zalgo the Explorer for .
Obsessed Prophet's Ornate Boots are sold by Zalgo the Explorer for .
Oathsworn Peacekeepers are earthen located throughout Dornogal.
Observational Notes: Cinderbees is found in Durgaz Cabin on the Isle of Dorn.
Observational Notes: Stormrooks is found inside the Freywold Village inn on the Isle of Dorn.
Observational Notes: Ramoliths is found inside Rambleshire inn on the Isle of Dorn.
Oathsworn Stormriders are earthen accompanying Baelgrim in the Tranquil Strand on the Isle of Dorn.
Oathsworn Traders are earthen located at the Crossroads Plaza on the Isle of Dorn.

The Oblivion Door is a platform in the central pit of the Ring of Containment in Uldir where Zul, Reborn is fought. It is initially inaccessible until all three bosses around the Ring of Containment—Zek'voz, Vectis, and the Fetid Devourer—have been defeated, allowing MOTHER to raise three stairways that allow players to cross the pit onto the platform. Zul is initially protected inside a sphere of blood until the hordes of surrounding blood trolls have been killed. After Zul is defeated, a Titan Console on the platform can be activated to open a large hole in the floor, allowing players to drop down to the Chamber of Corruption directly below.
The Observatorium is the last area in Castle Nathria. This is where players face Sire Denathrius.
Obsidian Blasting Powder is created with Engineering (300); taught by Schematic: Obsidian Blasting Powder.
Obsidian Bombs are created with Engineering (300); taught by Schematic: Obsidian Bomb.
Obsidian-Infused Thorium Bars are created with Mining (300); taught by Manual: Smelt Obsidian-Infused Thorium Bar.
Obsidian Defender is crafted with Blacksmithing (300); taught by Plans: Obsidian Defender.
Oathsworn Holdouts are earthen located at the Dock Lifts in the Rookery.
Oathsworn Tunnelwatchers are earthen who guard the tunnel leading from the Weaver's Lair in Azj-Kahet to Dornogal.

Obsidian Fragments drop from each boss during the Protocol Twilight mode, one of the modes available through the Elemental Rune Dungeon. They are used to purchase the following from Zarstrasza, Sylstrasza, and Lurah Wrathvine: *Dragon Soul LFR Gear *Normal Tier 12 Helm Tokens *Normal Tier 12 Shoulder Tokens *All Normal Difficulty Firelands Weapons (ilvl 378 and 384) *Normal Difficulty Ragnaros loot *All BoP random statted items (aka Flickering gear) from Heroic Firelands. **This gear will be purchased via a satchel, and the item stats will be generated once the item is removed from the bag. **The satchel also contains a chance to drop one of the following mounts: ***Flametalon of Alysrazor *
Obedient-ish Predator is a hyena located in the Sidestreet Sluice delve.

Objective Tracker displays active quests, tracked achievements, dungeon and scenario information like the bosses or current stage, and much more. It helps players keep track of their progress without needing to open the quest log manually.
Obliteration Beamglaive drops from the Plexus Sentinel in Manaforge Omega.
Oathsworn Defender's Leggings are a quest reward from This Is Our Dome!
Oathsworn Defender's Breeches are a quest reward from This Is Our Dome!
Oathsworn Defender's Greaves are a quest reward from This Is Our Dome!
Oathsworn Defender's Legguards are a quest reward from This Is Our Dome!
Observer's Soul Fetters drop from Ixthar the Unblinking and Sthaarbs in K'aresh. The trinket lets the user understand Eredun.
Oathsworn Vanguards are tauren Primalists summoned by Raszageth the Storm-Eater in the Vault of the Incarnates.
Observlings are observers located at the Tempest Fields on K'aresh
Oathsworn Stompers drop from Seranel Sunlash in Magisters' Terrace.
Observation Notes are found at Amberfall Mesa in Stormheim during Legion Assaults when Their Eyes Are Upon Us is up.
Oblivion Guise drops from Midnight Falls in the March on Quel'Danas.
Obliron is a voidlord located in Voidscar Arena. Along with Vexaroth, Nullatros, and Nyxovar, it must be slain in order to reach Charonus.
Oblivion Engines are K'areshi automatons located in the Voidspire.
Obsidian Enforcer is an ally card from the Twilight of the Dragons set.

Obsidian Drakonid is an ally card from the Twilight of the Dragons set.
Obsidian Drudge is an ally card from the Twilight of the Dragons set.
Obsidian Wingguard Polearm is sold by Samia Inkling and Xaldrass in the Waking Shores for .
Obsidian Proto-Whelp is sold by Lorena Belle and Atticus Belle in the Waking Shores for .
Obsidian Swoglets are hornswogs located at Scalecracker Keep in the Waking Shores.
Odd Mushroom is a mushroom found in the cave at under Windsong Rise that grows in size with each Enriched Soil used on it. After the fifth soil is used, Porta the Overgrown is summoned.

An Odd Totem can be found in the Abyssal Sands in , next to a large skeleton. If a shaman interacts with it, they will be turned into a Ghost Wolf. Successfully reaching the other Odd Totem at the other end of the skeleton without taking damage (which will cancel Ghost Wolf) will cause a Chest to appear with the Rune of Rolling Thunder.

Obsidian Hollow is a max-level shadow-filled corner of the Ringing Deeps, located centrally on the eastern wall of the zone. The area is bordered by the Chittering Den to the northwest, Shadowvein Point to the west, and the Rumbling Wastes to the southwest. With War Mode enabled, the area is a Free For All and Foggy Faceoff is sometimes available.

The Odd Murloc Egg teaches the player how to summon Squirky, a baby murloc companion. However, this item wasn't made available and instead Squirky can be captured in pet battles on Seabreak Isle off the coast of Azsuna.

Obsidian Iris are flowers found in the Obsidian Enclave in Valdrakken. Scalecommander Cindrethresh uses them to make fireworks for Emberthal's Visage Day. They are also looted from Basket of Draconic Flowers and have a hidden use effect, altering the visuals of the user for five minutes:
Odd Glob of Wax is found in piles of Disturbed Earth all over Khaz Algar. Gnawbles tasks adventurers with acquiring at least ten per week in Rollin' Down in the Deeps.
Obsidian Observatory is an observatory found in the Waking Shores.
Obsidian Reavers are lava elementals found in the southwest part of the during the Blackrock Eruption event.
Obsidian Surgers are lava elementals found south of the Cauldron in the during the Blackrock Eruption event.
The Obsidian Lifepool is located at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores.
Occult Poison I is created with the Poisons skill; the recipe is learned from Manual of Occult Poison.
Obsidian Magi are dracthyr located in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.
Odd Burl is a container object that can be seen hanging in a tree branch in the Emerald Dream.

Ocular Commanders are Maw guards located at the Eye's Overlook in the Sanctum of Domination. They patrol the area and are accompanied by Mawsworn Lancers. They must be slain to draw the attention of the Eye of the Jailer.

Obsidian Scope is created with Engineering (300); taught by Schematic: Obsidian Scope.

Obsidian Stormhammer is crafted with Blacksmithing (300); taught by Plans: Obsidian Stormhammer.

Obsidian Warder Custodians are dracthyr located in the War Creche in the Forbidden Reach.
Odealia Hocus is a goblin located in the Hovel Hill in the Undermine.

The Ochre Delivery Rocket is a rocket mount that can be purchased for 11,375 Resonance Crystals from Shredz the Scrapper at Venture Plaza in Undermine after reaching reputation with the Venture Company.

Of Mice and Manaforges is awarded to players who defeat Plexus Sentinel after saving all mice from atomization in the Manaforge Omega on Normal difficulty or higher. This is one of the criteria of Glory of the Omega Raider. Two mice spawn each intermission, so all three intermission phases are required to complete this achievement. Each player can only pick up one mouse and players are allowed to die after picking up their mouse. Do not use any immunities, as that would clear the debuff.
Obsidian Golem Shards likely dropped from Obsidian Golems in Uldaman.
Odorant Oddity is a trash item that can sometimes be looted from chests at the end of completed delves from .

Obsidian Prowler's Garb is a 7-piece leather transmog set. The pieces drop from various Heroic dungeons, though the entire set can also be collected from Ensemble: Obsidian Prowler's Garb. It is a recolor of the rogue Nightslayer Armor set. ;Head *Mask of the Deceiver (sold by G'eras) *Savage Mask of the Lynx Lord (The Black Stalker, Underbog) ;Shoulders *Sun-Gilded Shouldercaps (Chrono Lord Deja, Black Morass) ;Chest *Chestguard of the Prowler (Vazruden, Hellfire Ramparts) ;Hands *Predatory Gloves (Tavarok, Mana-Tombs) ;Waist *Epoch's Whispering Cinch (Epoch Hunter, Durnholde Keep) ;Legs *Mennu's Scaled Leggings (Mennu the Betrayer, Slave Pens) ;Feet *Felboar Hide Shoes (The Cipher of Damna
Obsidian Guards are djaradin located in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.
Obsidium Punishers are lava elementals found at Fireplume Peak in the Molten Front.
Obsidian Sanctum Reforged is an achievement earned for defeating Sartharion in Obsidian Sanctum on Titan Reforged.

Oddsight Focus is an item acquireed and used in the Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle secret. Using the Focus places a Gift of Oddsight buff on the targeted player (or the player using it). The tooltip for Gift of Oddsight grants the buffed player two "lucky numbers." The second number indicates which "Radiant Echo?" the buffed player will "resonate" with, and interacting with the corresponding "Radiant Echo?" with Gift of Oddsight active will reveal information needed to complete Radiant Singer (the 11 o'clock pillar of the Felcycle secret). Also, Gift of Oddsight (when used with Starry-Eyed Goggles) reveals Hidden Footlocker in Ratts' Revenge.
Occlusion of Void drops from Lothraxion in Nexus-Point Xenas.
Obsidian Warder Pennant is housing decor that can be purchased for 10 Community Coupons from Hordranin, who appears in neighborhoods as part of the Reaching Beyond the Possible endeavor.
Obsidium Black Dye was a housing dye used to color certain housing decor. It could be crafted by alchemists or scribes via Dye Crafting with 1 Black Dye Pigment.
Obsidian Scale Treads are available for purchase at the Trading Post for 40 Trader's Tender.
Octagonal Ochre Window is housing decor created with Khaz Algar Jewelcrafting (80); taught by Makir in Dornogal.
Obsolete Servitors are automa found at the Catalyst Gardens in Zereth Mortis.
